data.title: 提弗洛斯 · 极光雪松林边缘短暂歇脚
data.action: 靠在覆雪松树旁仰望极光后转头微笑
data.lighting: 翠绿与淡紫交织的天空极光与雪面反光
data.description: 夜巡收尾时，天幕忽然垂下绵延数里的青紫极光。提弗洛斯停在挂满雪凇的冷杉下，呼出一团温热白雾，抬手把滑落的毛领拢紧，回头朝你眨了眨眼——「在萨米，撞见这种夜空就说明明天会是个好天气。」
data.promptProse: Standing beside frost-laden pine trees beneath ribbons of green and violet aurora, Typhoeus turns back toward the viewer with a bright, serene smile as cool celestial light shimmers across the snow.
data.animaCaption: She pauses beside snow-laden pines beneath the glowing aurora sky, turning back with a warm smile.
